tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs mchod kyi rim pa la/ tshogs rdzas rnams bdud rtsi ril bus bsang gtor byas nas/ lag pa g.yon gdeng*/1$0000210 oṃ yig tu song bas sbyangs/ 1$0000210lag pa g.yas pa gdeng*/1$0000210 āḥyig gis rtogs pa ste mang por spel/ 1$0000210snyim pa bkab ste/1$0000210 hūm̐ yig gi sbar ba ste kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par byas/ 1$0000210mkha' lding gi phyag rgya/1$0000210 ho zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu bar 1$0000210bsam/1$0000210 hūm̐/ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// dpal rdo rje yan lag ma mo'i 'phrul// mtshan kun ldan ye shes ka pā la// de bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' tsam// ā rā li rnal 'byor gyi 'dus pa las// 'dod yon gyi longs spyod mi zad pa// ha ho hrīḥkha dog dri ro'i tshogs// mchog rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i dpyid// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyangs rtog sbar bas na// dpal mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gnas// sa ha dza so so rang rig gis// kha sbyor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu sdom// 1$0000210tshogs la spyan drangs nas/1$0000210 hūm̐ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsung chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad pa// sku rnam pa kun ldan tshogs kyi mchog /skyabs gsum gyi 'dus pa bla ma rje// 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs lings se ling*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// yab khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor gyi padmo'i snying po kun// ris med pa rgyal ba'i ze'u 'brus gang*// dngos grub kyi zil dngar ci dang ci// yid bzhin du 'byung ba'i lhag pa'i lha// 'khor yi dam lha tshogs nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs lings se ling*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// lha khyod dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// nang ye shes nyi ma zla ba'i brdzu// bar chad kyi mun pa mthar byed cing*// yid skyobs kyi snang ba kun ston pa// yum rdo rje btsun mo rigs lnga'i sde// 'khor dpa' bo ḍākki nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs lings se ling*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// ma khyod dang mnyam par byin gyi rlobs// khong bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo brlag byed du// dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i stobs// lha mi bzad khros pa dpa' bo'i sde// mgon ma hā kā la lcam dral rnams// 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs lings se ling*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// mgon khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs//

1$0000210tshogs kyi mchod pa/1$0000210 rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// chu zla bzhin 'gog pa med 'char ba// dpal dang po'i mgon po bla ma'i zhabs// dkar brgyud kyi rje btsun rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol bas// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer gyis// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// oṃ badzra gu ru ḍākki nī siddhi hūm̐/ rtsa brgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar la shar nas// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mgon mdzad pa// yi dam gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol bas// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer gyis// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gnyis med la gnyis su ston byed pa// sras rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// dpa' bo dang ḍākki rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol bas// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer gyis// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

bdud tshogs la bdud dang chos par gnyen// snying rje las rnam pa thams cad pa// khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dga' mar bcas// dam can gyi chos skyong rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba'i chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi sprin du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol bas// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer gyis// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi// 1$0000220mchod 'os bskang bshags dang*/ rtsa ltung bshags pa sogs 'don/ tshogs la 'dod pa lnga ldan du rol lo// lhag ma bsdus la kha spru btab ste/1$0000280 hūm̐/ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// 'khor gnas dang pho nya 'jig rten dang*// dam tshig dang sha za'i ḍā ki? ma// mdangs dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// lus glog 'khyug me dpung 'u ru ru// ngag bshug glu zhud po di ri ri// yid sangs rgyas bstan la dung nge dung*// las srid gsum myul la sha ra ra// mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed// dam nyams pa'i steng du thog tu babs// bar dur khrod kun tu rgyu zhing 'phur// dgra tho lum 'bar ba'i ro ru za// dma' rgya mtsho'i klong nas gyen la rgyugs// mi dam nyams bsgral nas khrag la 'thung*// nad brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi bdag /pho 'tshar po kun gyi snying la 'jug /mo 'tshar mo thams cad zhe yis gnon// gnas dben par sgom pa'i drod tshad nyul// khyed dgyes pa'i lhag gtor bshams nas 'bul// nged skal ldan dga' ba'i dngos grub zhu// oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba lingta bhakṣa bhya swā hā/ 1$0000220zhes phyi rol du phul/ lam zab bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs mchod kyi rim pa kun mkhyen rje'i gsung gsang ste zhal rgyun ltar bkod pa'o//
